Do the conditions
change the hours?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

Yes. With the PIN in place
the 9pm watershed
does not apply at all

Answer: it may run at 2:30pm,
